title: Mature-onset obesity in p62-deficient male mice maintains skeletal muscle mass despite metabolic dysfunction.
abstract: Sequestosome 1 (p62/SQSTM1) is a multifunctional scaffolding protein at the intersection of autophagy and metabolic regulation.
